name: Theocritus' Retrieval
summary: In Redridge, an adventurer finds a gnoll pendant and hears a voice through it. The voice belongs to Theocritus, High Mage of Tower of Azora, who has intercepted the gnolls' mystical network and urgently asks for the pendant to study.

sections.title: A Voice in the Stone
sections.body: Across the Redridge Mountains, travelers fighting the savage Shadowhide gnolls sometimes find a Shadowhide Pendant. Touching the enchanted trinket brings a calm, distant voice instead of barking or curses. The speaker is Theocritus, a human mage at Tower of Azora, across the border in Elwynn Forest. His message comes from long research into breaking the dark sorceries that direct the gnoll packs.

sections.title: Subverting Morganth's Network
sections.body: The Shadowhide gnolls obey Morganth, a rogue dark caster hidden in the mountains, as well as their own instincts. Morganth makes enchanted pendants to send commands to his gnoll followers. Theocritus spent months unraveling the frequency of Morganth's sending spells. When you bring the faded pendant to Tower of Azora, Theocritus confirms his scrying reached it. Now he can study how to reverse the magic and disable the gnolls.

aliases: who is talking through the pendant
faq.answer: Theocritus is a high mage of the Alliance at Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. He watches for trouble in the region and studies ways to counter dark magic spreading from Redridge.

faq.q: Why were the Shadowhide gnolls carrying magical pendants?
faq.answer: Morganth, a renegade wizard, made the pendants as magical conduits. He uses them to send mental commands and direct the Shadowhide clan from afar.

faq.q: Why was the voice delayed when Theocritus sent it?
faq.answer: Theocritus sent his message weeks before you found the stone, and first believed the spell had faded without reaching it. Breaking through Morganth's dark wards and linking across such a vast distance delayed the message.

faq.q: What does Theocritus hope to achieve with the retrieved pendant?
faq.answer: Theocritus hopes to read the magical frequency linking the pendant to Morganth and reverse its flow. He aims to send an offensive spell through the network that could instantly immobilize every gnoll wearing a pendant.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead next?
faq.answer: Bringing the pendant to Theocritus completes this errand. His separate struggle against Morganth continues in 'A Watchful Eye', which sends you to spy on Morganth's stronghold at the Tower of Ilgalar.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see ingenious use of abjuration and divination in Theocritus's work: he breaks into another sorcerer's network to send counterspells across vast distances.
As an Alliance member, you can see Tower of Azora in Elwynn working with Lakeshire's beleaguered defenders. Local mages step in where Stormwind's royal army has left garrisons understaffed.
